title: Authorize an accepted section without starting implementation
preconditions: The section work package is accepted as the planning baseline.
The repository starting checkpoint is clean and exact.

required_human_authority.decision: Issue an exact section implementation authorization.

stop_conditions: Stop before implementation when any checkpoint or scope guard fails.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not start implementation as part of the transition record.
Do not push, merge, release, migrate, or authorize a later section.
